name: Blue Horizon Energy
old_description: Since 2009 we’ve helped hundreds of businesses and communities move toward a more sustainable future through clean energy. As a full-service clean energy development company, we form a close partnership with our customers to handle all aspects of their solar energy and energy storage projects.
about:
Blue Horizon Energy was founded in 2009 in Plymouth, Minnesota, as a full-service clean energy development company. The firm began by helping homeowners and small businesses adopt solar power and has since expanded to serve complex energy projects across the Midwest. Leadership includes CEO Griffin Dooling and a senior team overseeing revenue, development, construction, and service operations.

The company provides end-to-end engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for solar photovoltaic systems, battery energy storage (BESS), and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. Its in-house construction crew, described as dozens of tradespeople, handles permitting, installation, and commissioning for projects ranging from agricultural arrays to enterprise-scale installations. The firm emphasizes a single-partner model covering development, design, construction, and long-term service.

Blue Horizon Energy serves agricultural operations, commercial property owners, civic institutions, and enterprise-scale clients. Representative projects include installations for Skaurud Farms, Lakeview Industries, the City of Wayzata, Richardson Nature Center, and logistics facilities such as Superior 3rd Party Logistics. The portfolio spans rooftop, ground-mount, and tracker-based solar arrays paired with storage where needed.

The company states its differentiation lies in a relentless focus on energy yield and quality, backed by industry-leading warranties, and a partnership approach that manages every project phase from initial assessment through ongoing maintenance. This model aims to deliver predictable long-term savings and reliable performance for customers.
